_comment: Paste the mcpServers block into your client config.
Cowork: Settings -> Connectors -> Add local server.
Claude Code: claude mcp add stl-transit --scope user --env STL_HOME=<repo> -- <repo>/.venv/bin/stl-mcp
Both paths must be ABSOLUTE. STL_HOME decides where snapshots live; pointing
it at the repo (gitignored) keeps everything an agent touched next to the
code, which is what makes a session reproducible after the fact.
No API keys: every source is public and unauthenticated.
